race.comment: THE MOUNT (2) looks to have found a highly-suitable first-up option here, particularly given his fresh record. Yet to win fresh, but has not missed a place in three runs. The low draw only aids his chances. AMERICAN RUSS (3) doesn't win out of turn but was in the finish last time when beaten a long neck into second over 1009m at Echuca. Has good early speed so should take up a forward position. Doubt he leads ADKI (9), though. She's past her best but always needs to be respected on these tracks where racing handy can be a big advantage and she's drawn the inside. STEELY HUSTLER (8) finished fourth when first-up from a spell last start over 1000m at Donald after racing on the pace for much of the way. Well placed and expected to feature. MINESITE (1) hasn't raced since finishing fifth over 1200m at Ballarat Synthetic on July 7 but goes well when resuming from a spell, including three minor placings from five starts.
